meta.title: The MKR Camp: Wrestling in Dagestan, MMA in Chechnya
meta.description: MMA camp in Chechnya or Wrestling camp in Dagestan, 1 to 3 weeks in the Caucasus. Russian visa, domestic flight from Istanbul, accommodation, 2 meals per day and local coaching included.

hero.label: THE CAMP
hero.title: 1 TO 3 WEEKS THAT CHANGE THE WAY YOU FIGHT.
hero.subtitle: Total immersion in the Caucasus. Wrestling in Dagestan, MMA in Chechnya. Coaching, accommodation and meals handled. You just fight.

tldr.title: In short · The MKR Camp
facts: Flexible duration: 1, 2 or 3 weeks within a 3-week window (4 sessions per year).
Two exclusive destinations per session: Wrestling in Dagestan (Makhachkala/Kaspiysk) or MMA in Chechnya (Grozny).
2 training sessions per day, 6 days a week. Wrestling at 10:30 and 17:30, MMA at 11:00 and 18:00.
Included: Russian visa, domestic flight Istanbul-Caucasus, accommodation, 2 meals per day, transfers, local coaching staff. International flight on your side.
Capacity: 15 Wrestling spots + 15 MMA spots per session (exclusive). Combo Wrestling + MMA available only as Custom Camp.

cinematic.label: IMMERSION
cinematic.title: THE CAUCASUS ON THE MAT
cinematic.tagline: Daily sparring with local fighters. Methods passed down from generation to generation.

philosophie.label: PHILOSOPHY
philosophie.title: WHY THE CAUCASUS
philosophie.p1: The best fighters on the planet all come from the same place. The Caucasus. Here, fighting methods have been passed down from father to son for centuries. Mats, sweat, and coaches who have built world champions.
philosophie.p2: MKR opens the doors of this world to you. Whether you are an experienced competitor or a serious amateur who wants to live elite conditions, you train at the same level of demand.

card_immersion.title: TOTAL IMMERSION
card_immersion.body: For 1 to 3 weeks, you live, eat and train with local athletes. Complete immersion in Caucasian fighting culture.

card_heritage.title: HERITAGE OF THE CAUCASUS
card_heritage.body: Methods that have produced Khabib, Makhachev, and hundreds of Olympic wrestling champions. In Grozny, Akhmat Fight Club has shaped Khamzat Chimaev and the new generation of MMA.

visa.title: Russian visa
visa.desc: Consular fees, invitation letter, EU questionnaire and file support. Everything is included.

flight.title: Domestic flight
flight.desc: From Istanbul to Makhachkala (Wrestling) or Grozny (MMA). You only organize the flight to Istanbul.

transport.title: Local transport
transport.desc: Airport-camp transfers and all on-site travel.

accommodation.title: Accommodation
accommodation.desc: Shared camp lodging, clean and functional. You focus on training.

sessions.title: 2 sessions/day
sessions.desc: Twice-daily training in your discipline. Morning and late afternoon.

coaches.title: Local coaches
coaches.desc: Champions and veterans of the Caucasus. Methods passed down from generation to generation.

excursions.title: Excursions
excursions.desc: Mountain hikes and cultural visits on the rest day.

meals.title: 2 meals/day
meals.desc: Caucasian cuisine rich in protein. Diet adapted to athletes.

not_included.label: NOT INCLUDED
not_included.title: WHAT IS NOT INCLUDED
items: Personal equipment (gloves, shin guards, mouthguard, groin protection)
Personal expenses on site (drinks, shopping, tips)
MKR surcharge for applications under 30 days before departure (express processing)

slots.desc: The morning belongs to those who rise early.
Hearty meal, protein, energy for the morning.
Wrestling (adults or youth) at 10:30. MMA at 11:00. Sparring, technique, drills.
Wrestling at 17:30. MMA at 18:00. Competition intensity, supervised sparring.
Evening meal free according to your personal plan.
